target_customer: Foreign language learners who want vocabulary flashcards with spaced repetition on iOS
problem: Learners needed ready-made vocabulary decks with audio, images and example sentences instead of building their own cards.
business_model: Consumer app with free self-made decks and premium decks at about 3 dollars per month
product_category: Spaced repetition flashcard app for language learning

founders.name: Justin Cannon
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as sole founder with no background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard SM-2 scheduling in a mobile app with sync, where the main work was content creation.

defensibility.rationale: The scheduling algorithm is public and decks of common words are easy to replicate, so nothing prevented copying.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acted on it; the app appears to have gone unmaintained, with a French App Store page showing a last version dated 2018.

market_need_then: Spaced repetition was an established method with free tools such as Anki, and the founder's pitch was convenient prebuilt decks; no dated demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Site at cleverdeck.com, linked from the App Store listing.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand assets were found beyond store listings, and search results confuse it with unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: CleverDeck is a one-person iOS flashcard app from YC Winter 2012 that is still listed as active, with a live site and premium decks. No funding, traction or acquisition was found, and store data suggests updates stopped years ago, so the outcome is unclear.
notes: No funding found; none_found means unknown, not zero. A Caplight page for a different CleverDeck was disregarded. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found. Last update dates conflict (2018 vs 2021) across aggregators. Founding year is not sourced.
